title: Text
description: Plite text node types and pure text helpers.
---

Text nodes contain document text and leaf marks. Pure helpers live on
`TextApi`; editor text reads live under `editor.read.text`.

See the canonical [Text reference](/docs/plite/api/nodes/text).
